record.reason: The paper diagnoses weakest-link and recognition bottlenecks in multi-hop QA, with experiments across context positions, datasets, and model scales. It analyzes reasoning failure modes rather than proposing a compute-, KV-cache-, memory-, or latency-saving inference method.
record.title: Failure Modes in Multi-Hop QA: The Weakest Link Effect and the Recognition Bottleneck
